networks.name: plumbline_desk
networks.description: Check an agentic website with the gate, read its drift, verify its publisher signature, and make a key and sign agent files in your browser.
sample_queries: Run the gate on https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/ and tell me what each checker said.
Has https://montbaga.github.io/agent-customs/ drifted from its published lock?
Verify the Plumbline signature of https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/ and explain the verdict.
Make me a new publisher key.
Sign the agent files I picked on the page.
Certify that https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/ is safe for everyone to use.

peer_policy.note: Calls the partner sites in allowed_peers (Agent Atlas and Agent Customs) only after the visitor agrees on a card, plus page-local actions.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
